name: cribl-lhe-performance
description: Run, compare, and review repeatable Cribl Search performance tests, on Lakehouse engine sizes and on federated search over remote data.

scripts.deploy: npm run verify && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version >/dev/null && apps package --version "$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && cribl-app-deploy --artifact "build/$npm_package_name-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").tgz"
scripts.deploy:version: npm pkg set version="$VERSION" && npm run verify && apps package --version "$VERSION" && cribl-app-deploy --artifact "build/$npm_package_name-$VERSION.tgz"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && tsc -b
